author: BoomBlast77
quote:
Waited over a decade to play this game.

The framerate drops are horrendous to the point it's too jarring to play.

I've played maybe 20 hours so far and had to take breaks due to feeling nauseous.

I'll get the game for pc when it's available and change my review based on that experience.

Until then - this is the highest rating I can give it and it's justified. If I can't play a game I've waited 10 years for due to performance issues - it's not getting a good review.

Ps5 Pro
